
	<h1 class="postTitle"><a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/bugse/p/21043372" title="发布于 2026-07-03 16:05">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">使用embedchain快速建立rag知识库，本地大模型</span>
    

</a>
</h1>
	<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span class="marker">初学RAG搭建知识库，强烈建议先利用embedchain这个开源的RAG框架，短短几行代码就能让你快速建立一个私人知识库，并支持随时增加知识源，是理想的学习和使用RAG知识的开源利器</span></p>
<p align="left">最简单的解决方式:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>框架:</strong> Embedchain</li>
<li><strong>LLM:</strong> Ollama</li>
<li><strong>嵌入式模型:</strong> nomic-embed-text 或 bge-m3</li>
<li><strong>向量数据库:</strong> ChromaDB (默认)</li>
</ul>
<p>按照步骤依次进行：</p>
<p>安装ollama等模型：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>pip <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span> embedchain ollama chromadb sentence-transformers</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>Windows平台，<span>&nbsp;需要去<a href="https://ollama.com/download" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank"><span>https://ollama.com/download</span></a><span> 下载 Windows 安装程序（<code>.exe</code><span>），运行安装，务必在安装过程中勾选“Add Ollama to your PATH”<span>。</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span><span><span>下载大模型到本地：</span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>ollama pull llama3.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span><span><span><span>下载embedding model:</span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>ollama pull nomic-embed-text</pre>
</div>
<p>启动ollama</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ollama serve
测试ollama是否启动
curl http:</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">localhost:11434/api/tags</span></pre>
</div>
<p>设置embedchain :</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> embedchain <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> App
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os
os.environ[</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">OPENAI_API_KEY</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>] = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ollama</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Ollama 不校验，填任意值</span>
os.environ[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">OPENAI_API_BASE</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>] = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">http://localhost:11434/v1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
config </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">vectordb</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">provider</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">chroma</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">config</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">collection_name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ollama_openai_compat</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        }
    },
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">llm</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">provider</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">openai</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,          <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用 openai provider</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">config</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">model</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">llama3.2</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,       <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 模型名称</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">temperature</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: 0.1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">max_tokens</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: 2000<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        }
    },
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">embedder</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">provider</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">openai</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">config</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">model</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">nomic-embed-text</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 嵌入模型</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
    }
}

app </span>= App.from_config(config=config)</pre>
</div>
<p>增加文档:</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>app.add(r<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">E:\拿破仑传.pdf</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, data_type=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pdf_file</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>增加问题：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>response = app.query(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">拿破仑去世时间</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(response)</pre>
</div>
<p>完整的代码：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> embedchain <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> App

    }

app </span>= App.from_config(config=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">config)
app.add(r</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">E:\拿破仑传.pdf</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, data_type=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pdf_file</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(response)</pre>
</div>
<p>最后输出答案:</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>拿破仑于1815年去世。</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>embedchain github地址<a href="https://github.com/hypier/embedchain" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">:https://github.com/hypier/embedchain</a></p>
<p>总结一下遇到的问题：</p>
<p>问题1：依赖包版本不兼容</p>
<p>这个问题最好是单独建立一套虚拟环境，然后在这套虚拟环境下执行上面的命令</p>
<p>问题2：sqlalchemy.exc.OperationalError: (sqlite3.OperationalError) table ec_chat_history already exists&nbsp; &nbsp; </p>
<p>这个是因为我在测试时已经建立过一次向量数据库，手动删除embedchain.db后问题解决</p>

</div>
